levels.cache: sha256 of uint8 cache array images[i] (3x256x256, protocol-v1 cache = training/evaluation input)
levels.file: sha256 of the original image file bytes in the split folder
levels.pixel: sha256 of the decoded original RGB array at native resolution (PIL convert RGB)

count_rule: pair counts are counted on the second set (val for train-val, test for train-test, val-test, test-any)
